# VR-4: What Drives the Relay Transcriptionally?

## Overview

This notebook resolves why `Zbtb16`/PLZF is absent from pySCENIC summaries, tests whether any called regulon tracks the olfactory–amygdalar chemosensory relay along chain positions 1–4, looks for opposite-direction regulons across glutamatergic input vs GABAergic output limbs, and scores a retinoic-acid target module. AUCell is never pooled raw across tissue×class runs.

## Background

`Zbtb16` was the most attractive master-regulator hypothesis and is missing from SCENIC hit tables. Absence can mean (a) never called, (b) called but not class-significant, or (c) called and significant but missed in summaries — with very different consequences. Independently, an unbiased relay-regulon scan asks which TFs, if any, show a monotone gradient along the chain after adjusting for `n_cells` and median UMI.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(glue)
  library(data.table)
})
source(file.path(wkdir, "notebooks/R_scripts/vr_relay_helpers.R"))
paths <- vr_paths(wkdir)

amy_classes <- c(
  "09" = "snRNASeq_AMY_CS20230722_CLAS_09",
  "11" = "snRNASeq_AMY_CS20230722_CLAS_11",
  "13" = "snRNASeq_AMY_CS20230722_CLAS_13"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-zbtb
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

parse_regulon_tfs <- function(regulons_csv) {
  # pySCENIC ctx export: rows after header; TF in first column
  raw <- readLines(regulons_csv, warn = FALSE)
  # Find data rows where first field looks like a TF symbol
  tfs <- character()
  for (ln in raw) {
    fields <- strsplit(ln, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (!length(fields)) next
    tf <- fields[[1]]
    if (grepl("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+$", tf) && !tf %in% c("TF", "MotifID")) {
      tfs <- c(tfs, tf)
    }
  }
  unique(tfs)
}

auc_has_tf <- function(auc_csv, tf = "Zbtb16") {
  hdr <- strsplit(readLines(auc_csv, n = 1), ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  any(grepl(paste0("^", tf, "\\(\\+\\)$"), hdr))
}

cases <- lapply(names(amy_classes), function(cl) {
  d <- file.path(paths$scenic_by_class, amy_classes[[cl]])
  reg <- file.path(d, "regulons.csv")
  auc <- file.path(d, "auc_mtx.csv")
  diff <- file.path(d, "diff_regulons_WildR_vs_SPF.csv")
  tfs <- if (file.exists(reg)) parse_regulon_tfs(reg) else character()
  called <- "Zbtb16" %in% tfs
  in_auc <- file.exists(auc) && auc_has_tf(auc, "Zbtb16")
  sig <- FALSE
  if (file.exists(diff)) {
    dr <- read_csv(diff, show_col_types = FALSE)
    rcol <- intersect(names(dr), c("regulon", "Regulon", "tf"))[1]
    pcol <- intersect(names(dr), c("padj", "p_adj", "fdr"))[1]
    if (!is.na(rcol)) {
      hit <- grepl("Zbtb16", dr[[rcol]])
      if (any(hit) && !is.na(pcol)) sig <- any(dr[[pcol]][hit] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (any(hit) && is.na(pcol)) sig <- TRUE
    }
  }
  tibble(class = cl, dir = amy_classes[[cl]], called = called, in_auc = in_auc, class_significant = sig)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Decision: (a) never called; (b) called not sig; (c) called and sig
overall <- if (!any(cases$called) && !any(cases$in_auc)) {
  "a"
} else if (any(cases$called | cases$in_auc) && !any(cases$class_significant)) {
  "b"
} else {
  "c"
}

case_sentence <- switch(
  overall,
  a = "**Case (a): Regulon never called** in AMY classes 09 CNU-LGE GABA, 11 CNU-HYa GABA, or 13 CNU-HYa Glut — motif enrichment did not yield a `Zbtb16(+)` regulon, so SCENIC absence carries **no information** about activity; `Zbtb16` reverts to a plain DE hit.",
  b = "**Case (b): Regulon called but not significant at class level** — proceed to supertype-resolution AUCell test in MeA/COAp.",
  c = "**Case (c): Regulon called and significant at class level** — prior summary was resolution-limited; still run supertype test."
)

lines <- c(
  case_sentence,
  "",
  "## Evidence by class",
  "",
  paste(capture.output(print(cases)), collapse = "\n"),
  "",
  "## Implication",
  if (overall == "a") {
    "- Do **not** report SCENIC absence as evidence against the TF hypothesis. Elevate `Eps8l1` as the primary thread-1 signal pending other support."
  } else {
    "- See `VR4_zbtb16_supertype_test.csv` for per-animal MeA/COAp AUCell contrast."
  },
  ""
)
write_md(zbtb_md, lines)

# Supertype test only if called
if (overall %in% c("b", "c")) {
  cell_meta <- read_csv(paths$scenic_cell_meta, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      cell_id = as.character(cell_id),
      animal = gsub("_(AMY|HYP)$", "", sample),
      group = microbiome,
      chain_position = assign_chain_position(supertype_name)
    )
  # Load AUC from classes that have Zbtb16(+)
  auc_rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cases))) {
    if (!isTRUE(cases$in_auc[i])) next
    auc <- fread(file.path(paths$scenic_by_class, cases$dir[i], "auc_mtx.csv"))
    zcol <- grep("^Zbtb16\\(\\+\\)$", names(auc), value = TRUE)[1]
    auc_rows[[length(auc_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      cell_id = as.character(auc[[1]]),
      auc = as.numeric(auc[[zcol]]),
      class = cases$class[i]
    )
  }
  if (length(auc_rows)) {
    aa <- bind_rows(auc_rows) %>%
      inner_join(cell_meta, by = "cell_id") %>%
      filter(tissue == "AMY", grepl("MEA|COAp", supertype_name)) %>%
      # z within class
      group_by(class) %>%
      mutate(auc_z = as.numeric(scale(auc))) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(animal, group) %>%
      summarise(auc_mean = mean(auc_z, na.rm = TRUE), n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")
    cd <- cliffs_delta(aa$auc_mean[aa$group == "WildR"], aa$auc_mean[aa$group == "SPF"])
    sep <- complete_separation(aa$auc_mean, aa$group)
    aa$cliff_delta <- cd$delta
    aa$cliff_ci_low <- cd$ci_low
    aa$cliff_ci_high <- cd$ci_high
    aa$n_wildr_exceed_all_spf <- sep$n_exceed_all
    write_csv(aa, zbtb_csv)
  }
} else {
  write_csv(tibble(note = "Zbtb16 regulon not called; supertype AUCell test not applicable"), zbtb_csv)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-scan
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

cell_meta <- read_csv(paths$scenic_cell_meta, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_id = as.character(cell_id),
    animal = gsub("_(AMY|HYP)$", "", sample),
    group = microbiome,
    chain_position = assign_chain_position(supertype_name)
  )

# Per-class AUCell → within-class z → per-animal × chain-position means
load_class_auc_long <- function(class_dir, class_id) {
  auc_f <- file.path(paths$scenic_by_class, class_dir, "auc_mtx.csv")
  if (!file.exists(auc_f)) return(NULL)
  auc <- fread(auc_f)
  cell <- as.character(auc[[1]])
  mat <- as.matrix(auc[, -1])
  # z-score each regulon across cells in this class
  mat_z <- scale(mat)
  colnames(mat_z) <- colnames(mat)
  as_tibble(mat_z) %>%
    mutate(cell_id = cell, class = class_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(cell_id, class), names_to = "regulon", values_to = "auc_z")
}

auc_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(amy_classes), function(cl) {
  load_class_auc_long(amy_classes[[cl]], cl)
}))

joined <- auc_long %>%
  inner_join(cell_meta %>% select(cell_id, animal, group, tissue, supertype_name,
                                  chain_position), by = "cell_id") %>%
  filter(tissue == "AMY", chain_position %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "3G"))

# Covariates per animal × position
covar <- joined %>%
  distinct(cell_id, animal, chain_position, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(animal, chain_position, name = "n_cells")

# Per-animal mean AUCell by position (positions 1–4 for gradient)
anim_pos <- joined %>%
  filter(chain_position %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")) %>%
  group_by(regulon, animal, group, chain_position) %>%
  summarise(auc = mean(auc_z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pos = as.integer(chain_position)) %>%
  left_join(covar, by = c("animal", "chain_position"))

# WildR − SPF difference per regulon × position, then regress on position
grad <- anim_pos %>%
  group_by(regulon, pos, chain_position) %>%
  summarise(
    delta = mean(auc[group == "WildR"], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(auc[group == "SPF"], na.rm = TRUE),
    med_n = median(n_cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fit_slope <- function(df, adjusted = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) < 3) return(tibble(slope = NA_real_, ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_))
  if (adjusted) {
    fit <- tryCatch(lm(delta ~ pos + med_n, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else {
    fit <- tryCatch(lm(delta ~ pos, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(slope = NA_real_, ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_))
  cf <- suppressWarnings(confint(fit))
  tibble(
    slope = unname(coef(fit)[["pos"]]),
    ci_low = unname(cf["pos", 1]),
    ci_high = unname(cf["pos", 2])
  )
}

scan <- grad %>%
  group_by(regulon) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    u <- fit_slope(.x, FALSE)
    a <- fit_slope(.x, TRUE)
    tibble(
      slope = u$slope, ci_low = u$ci_low, ci_high = u$ci_high,
      slope_adj = a$slope, ci_low_adj = a$ci_low, ci_high_adj = a$ci_high
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    abs_adj = abs(slope_adj),
    rank_adj = dense_rank(desc(abs_adj))
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank_adj)

write_csv(scan, scan_csv)

# Sanity: Mllt10 / Ube2k ranks
focal <- scan %>%
  filter(grepl("Mllt10|Ube2k", regulon)) %>%
  select(regulon, rank_adj, slope_adj, ci_low_adj, ci_high_adj)
write_csv(focal, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR4_recurrent_tf_ranks.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-limb
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

top20 <- scan %>% filter(rank_adj <= 20) %>% pull(regulon)

limb <- joined %>%
  filter(regulon %in% top20) %>%
  mutate(limb = case_when(
    chain_position %in% c("2", "3") ~ "input_glut",
    chain_position == "3G" ~ "output_gaba",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(limb)) %>%
  group_by(regulon, animal, group, limb) %>%
  summarise(auc = mean(auc_z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(regulon, limb) %>%
  summarise(
    delta = mean(auc[group == "WildR"], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(auc[group == "SPF"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = limb, values_from = delta) %>%
  mutate(
    opposite_direction = !is.na(input_glut) & !is.na(output_gaba) &
      (sign(input_glut) != sign(output_gaba)) & abs(input_glut) > 0 & abs(output_gaba) > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(opposite_direction), regulon)

write_csv(limb, limb_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-ra
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

ra_genes <- c("Rarb", "Crabp1", "Crabp2", "Dhrs3", "Rbp1", "Cyp26b1")
# Score via glut+gaba relay h5ads (Python subprocess — reticulate broken here)
relay_labels <- c(
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0039", "CS20230722_SUPT_0040", "CS20230722_SUPT_0041",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0042", "CS20230722_SUPT_0055", "CS20230722_SUPT_0056",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0057", "CS20230722_SUPT_0058", "CS20230722_SUPT_0061",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0338", "CS20230722_SUPT_0355", "CS20230722_SUPT_0359",
  "CS20230722_SUPT_0507"
)

ra_cell <- bind_rows(lapply(relay_labels, function(lab) {
  df <- score_unit_via_python(lab, ra_genes, character(), paths = paths)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      ra_score = score_pos_only,
      genes_used = length(ra_genes)
    )
}))

ra_animal <- ra_cell %>%
  group_by(animal, group) %>%
  summarise(ra_score = mean(ra_score, na.rm = TRUE), n_cells = n(),
            genes_used = max(genes_used), .groups = "drop")

cd <- cliffs_delta(ra_animal$ra_score[ra_animal$group == "WildR"],
                   ra_animal$ra_score[ra_animal$group == "SPF"])
sep <- complete_separation(ra_animal$ra_score, ra_animal$group)
wx <- wilcox.test(ra_score ~ group, data = ra_animal, exact = FALSE)

write_csv(ra_animal, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR4_ra_per_animal.csv"))
lines <- c(
  "# VR-4 retinoic-acid module",
  "",
  sprintf("- Genes scored: %s (intersection with expressed panel per unit).", paste(ra_genes, collapse = ", ")),
  sprintf("- Cliff's δ (WildR vs SPF): **%.3f** (95%% CI %.3f – %.3f).", cd$delta, cd$ci_low, cd$ci_high),
  sprintf("- Per-animal separation: %d / %d WildR exceed all SPF.", sep$n_exceed_all, sep$n_hi),
  sprintf("- Wilcoxon p (not headline): %.4g.", wx$p.value),
  "",
  "- Note: `Cyp26b1` is also a MAST hit and D-SPIN star program at `0368 CEA-BST Six3 Cyp26b1 Gaba_2`.",
  "",
  "Per-animal scores: `tables/VR4_ra_per_animal.csv`.",
  ""
)
write_md(ra_md, lines)
```
